description.overview: We are looking for a capable Executive Assistant to join our Secretarial & Executive Support team and contribute directly to our growth in Administration / Office / Executive Support / Legal.
topReasonsToJoin: 13th month salary plus performance-based bonus
Access to internal training courses and certification budget
16 days annual leave, above market standard
responsibilities: Handle core secretarial & executive support activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Deliver planning and resource allocation, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Process stakeholder communication and updates and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Deliver reporting and performance tracking to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Maintain collaboration with cross-functional departments, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Process quality standards and process compliance in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: At least 1-3 years of hands-on experience relevant to the Executive Assistant role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Laptop and equipment provided
Flexible working hours and hybrid option
Team building activities and company trips
16-18 days of paid annual leave
Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Opportunity to work with international partners

Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Ability to work independently and under pressure
Adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
